STH2.5G SERIES SWITCHES
DATASHEET
Flexible Campus and Enterprise Switch
Version: V1.0
Release Date: 2024/10/08
Product Overview
The STH2.5G series switches are designed a domestic new generation switch chip which is carried on VastLakes Platform.
They support ports of various speeds, provide full Gigabit access(PoE, non-PoE) and flexible uplink data interaction capabilities, support a variety of switch layer 3 features, ensure network security, high efficiency and energy saving, and are suitable for access scenarios such as e-sports networks and SMBs.
Key Features of the STH2.5G Series Switches
Support 5G Multi-Gigatbit ports and various uplink ports to meet different network requirements.
PoE++ provide max 90W power of ports.
Rich L2/L3 features such as IPv6, OSPF, BGP, PIM etc.
Support CLI/WEB/SNMP/SSH for flexible operation.
The STH2.5G series switches provide various power supply solutions for customers choosing. Generally, air flow of STH2.5G series is front to back (AFO), and some of models can do customization of back to front (AFI) airflow.

S4624P-2Z-EI	◯	◯	24 PoE++	◯	X	2	2

[slide 2]
The STH2.5G series switches support varied management ways, include console, and support SNMP v1/v2/v3, Support CLI (Command Line Interface), web management, Telnet and FTP connection. Support OAM to make management more convenient, and support SSH2.0, etc. to ensure security of management.
Visual WEB GUI
The STH2.5G series allows you to quickly configure common configuration items using a visual WEB GUI, which lowers the application threshold for users.
